usage: tortured_phrase_screening.py [-h]
                                    {validate-snapshot,scan-draft,validate-draft,render-draft,enrich-passport}
                                    ...

Hermetic tortured-phrase risk-marker screening for issue #660. The runtime
consumes only explicitly named local inputs. It never downloads a phrase list,
dereferences a corpus pointer, invokes a model, judges authorship, or rewrites
manuscript text. A deterministic match is carried as a heuristic advisory
because a curated-list hit is only a risk marker. CLI exit codes: 0 success, 1
fail-closed contract/replay error, 2 invocation error. A snapshot failure
still writes an explicit degraded/not-checked artifact when an output path was
supplied; it never becomes a clean result.

positional arguments:
  {validate-snapshot,scan-draft,validate-draft,render-draft,enrich-passport}
    validate-snapshot   Validate and hash-bind one local snapshot.
    scan-draft          Build a closed own-draft advisory
